[tense] ... went to get some pizza. I approached Fermat, who was sitting behind the counter, looking gloomy. ''I’d like some pizza'' I said. 
''Sure thing! What would you like in your pizza?'' he replied, fast and professional.

''The same as always, you know me.''

''I would like something new, daring, fresh.''

''That’d be pepperoni, tomato, rucola... and sunflower.''

''Don’t you ever clean the toilet?''

''The same as always, you know me''.
''I don’t. Have we ever met before?'', he answered, sticking his head out and staring at me.

''... Yes, I’ve come here twice a week for the past 10 years...''

''Yes, I’m the guy with the sunflower.''

''Yes, and you should really clean your toilet.''

''Are you serious? Come on! It’s me.''

Yes, I’ve come here twice a week for the past 10 years.''
''I couldn't tell'' he shrugged ''there’s a lot of people passing by. What would you like in your pizza?''

“I would like something new, daring, fresh.”

“That’d be pepperoni, tomato, rucola... and sunflower.”

“Don’t you ever clean the toilet?”

''I would like something new, daring, fresh.''
 ''All we have is pizza.'

''That’d be pepperoni, tomato, rucola... and sunflower'' I added, hoping to catch him off guard.
 ''Umm, ehh... we, we don’t have any of that,'' he mumbled, looking down. He had to be hiding something there! ''And now, now get out of here, the restaurant is too full!''

...approached the hobo sitting on the sidewalk next door. 
I figured that since he often spent the whole day sitting in the middle of the street, drugged on God knows what, he would know better than anyone what was going on inside the human soul, and thus could help me uncover the murderer. I sat next to him, but he didn’t seem to notice me. He was mumbling something to himself and making strange drawings on the pavement. On a second thought, he was probably just nuts.

I kept listening to him.

''Hey, hold on! What did you say about sunflowers?'' I asked without much hope. Surprisingly, he stopped his nonsense and kept silent for much longer than I thought possible. Not only he was silent. Everything was still.
 Suddenly, I started hearing the voices once again. ''Am I going crazy?'' I thought. 

''...''

 ''I must be dreaming all of this.''

''...''

Much to my relief, I came back to reality when he suddenly spat out:
''Sunflower.''
''One of a hundred.''

I kept listening, and he started vomiting words all over, shouting and moving his arms around. 
''will come the time and surely this time has come and past and come AGAIN till it passes away if only no one would PASS AWAY, y’know??
play would stop reap shot poison bomb the one we could keep doin keep gofin, keep moving forward! y'know? save it if you can save it yourself and don't waste my time, hey dude don’t waste my time, yesterday is gone tomorrow won't come just shut up SHUT UP and bend low bend down!!''

I bend down.

He sat silent, eyes closed. I bent down and closed my eyes as well. Completely alienated from the world of cars and  pedestrians passing by, I thought of my sunflower. That pacified my mind. Pacified my mind. Pacified my mind. When I opened my eyes again I found some ugly letters carved in the pavement. They read:
To save the sunflower you must
Control the water
Stop war
Steal the food
Make love stay
Drink the poison
The hobo looked at me with sparkly eyes. ''I made up the last one, so don’t take it so seriously haha'' He explained proudly, grinning his rotten teeth at me. ''Want some?'' And he offered me a glass bottle reeking of alcohol.

''Sure.''

''I’ll pass this time.''

''Sure'' I said, accepting the booze and taking a long gulp. ''Y’now'' He said eventually ''I wouldn't like to be in your position, much responsibility. Anyway, no hurry eh, me I just chillin man, just take it easy. Take your time. It is not like we are going anywhere.'' He told me. For once I forgot about it all.

''Isn’t that your bed?'' I asked.
''Yes indeed! The pictograms appeared in my bed this morning. A time traveler must have made them,'' he replied before falling soundly asleep. I went home.
